title: Regime Residual Portfolio
summary: A residual-alpha forecasting and portfolio-construction research pipeline built around walk-forward evaluation, validation embargoes, MC Dropout uncertainty and transaction-cost awareness.
proof_detail: Temporal leakage controls and explicit baselines are part of the evaluation design.
visual_alt: Walk-forward machine-learning diagram for regime residual portfolio research, with rolling training windows, uncertainty filtering and cost-aware portfolio construction.
problem: Financial backtests are unusually easy to contaminate with future information or frictionless assumptions. The project focuses on whether residual-return signals can be studied with a time-aware pipeline that separates prediction from portfolio decisions.
built: The workflow creates residual-alpha targets and market-regime features, trains models in rolling windows with an embargo, estimates predictive uncertainty with MC Dropout, filters signals, constructs monthly portfolios and evaluates turnover and transaction costs against explicit baselines.

decisions.title: Make time the first constraint.
decisions.text: Train and validation windows move forward and use an embargo to reduce contamination across adjacent periods.

decisions.title: Separate prediction from portfolio logic.
decisions.text: Model outputs are inputs to a downstream signal-filtering and allocation layer rather than being treated as trades by default.

decisions.title: Evaluate uncertainty and friction.
decisions.text: MC Dropout estimates predictive uncertainty, while turnover and costs keep the backtest closer to an implementable decision process.

results.label: baseline families
results.detail: equal weight, momentum and ridge-based prediction

results.label: uncertainty
results.detail: Dropout sampling used to filter uncertain signals

results.label: included
results.detail: turnover and transaction friction are tracked in the evaluation

constraints: The repository explicitly does not claim guaranteed alpha or future investment performance.
Results are sensitive to universe construction, costs, non-stationarity and data quality.
The main signal of the project is time-aware ML methodology rather than a single backtest number.
